designs.title: Pisa
designs.why: Clean, well-drawn one-ink stamp: perforations, double frame and the arcade detail all hold at full size, and '3.97°' (the tower's real lean) is a smart nerd wink. But the main gag is muddled. The tower is drawn plumb and the whole stamp is rotated, so on the body the tower reads as standing straight and the lean disappears. Up close, the flat tower base sits on a ground line that slopes with the frame, leaving a wedge gap on one side. Every line is the same weight and nothing is roughed up, so it reads as airport-souvenir vector clip art rather than something with attitude. It also feels timid at this size in the middle of the back.
designs.fix: Make the lean the hero: square the stamp to the body and tilt the tower about 4 degrees inside it, sitting on a level ground line, so the joke reads from 3 m and the '3.97°' pays it off. While doing that, give the outer frame and tower silhouette heavier weights than the interior detail.
